title: American Gluten-Free Beef Burger
description: A delicious beef burger cooked to perfection in the oven with a crispy crust, served on a gluten-free bun.

ingredients.name: Gluten-Free Buns
ingredients.notes: available at most health food stores

instructions: Divide the ground beef into 4 equal portions and shape into patties.
Sprinkle the crusted burger mix onto both sides of the patties.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 160°F (71°C).
While the burgers are cooking, toast the gluten-free buns on the oven rack.
Assemble the burgers with American cheese, onions, lettuce, tomatoes, and mayonnaise.
